trip.title: Your Trip
trip.subtitle: A week in London, Paris and Buxton

segments.title: Fly to London
segments.detail: Virgin Atlantic VS20, a direct overnight flight to Heathrow that takes about 10 hours and 20 minutes in economy. You have one carry-on up to 10kg plus a personal item, and no checked bags.

segments.title: Land at Heathrow
segments.info: Take the Elizabeth line into town
segments.detail: Clear passport control, then ride the Elizabeth line to Paddington, roughly 30 minutes and about 13 pounds. Your contactless card works directly, so you do not need an Oyster card.

segments.title: Check in to the hotel

commute.summary: Elizabeth line to Paddington, about 30 minutes

segments.detail: Four Points Flex by Sheraton on Upper Woburn Place. It is a windowless double pod, very dark and good for jet lagged sleep. No breakfast is included, and they take a 100 pound damage deposit on arrival that is refunded within a week. Check out is Wednesday by noon.

pin.name: Four Points Flex by Sheraton London Euston
pin.address: 8-11 Upper Woburn Place, London WC1H 0JV, UK

segments.title: Wander Notting Hill

commute.summary: One stop on the Elizabeth line, about 5 minutes

segments.detail: One stop on the Elizabeth line from Paddington to Notting Hill Gate. The Portobello Road antiques market winds down around 5pm, so head there first. There are pastel terraces on Lansdowne Road, the Electric Cinema, and good independent coffee. An easy way to decompress after the flight.

segments.title: Dinner at Fallow
segments.detail: One of the best places in London right now, with nose to tail British cooking and excellent cocktails. It is about 20 minutes from Notting Hill Gate by Tube. Save your appetite, and budget around 80 to 100 pounds with drinks.

pin.name: Fallow St James's
pin.address: 2 St James's Market, London SW1Y 4AH, UK

days.label: Sightseeing, then the train to Paris

segments.title: Westminster Abbey
segments.info: Book a timed entry, about 27 pounds
segments.detail: Every British monarch since 1066 was crowned here. Arrive for the 9am opening to beat the tour groups, and allow about 90 minutes. Book your timed entry in advance.

segments.title: British Museum
segments.detail: The Rosetta Stone, Egyptian mummies, the Parthenon sculptures, and the Great Court. Allow about two hours. Entry is free but you still need to reserve a timed slot online. It is a five minute walk from the hotel.

pin.name: The British Museum
pin.address: Great Russell St, London WC1B 3DG, UK

segments.title: Eurostar to Paris
segments.detail: About two and a half hours direct to Gare du Nord. Arrive at St Pancras 60 to 90 minutes early for the airport style passport control and security. Gates close 30 minutes before departure. Complete your advance passenger information beforehand, since you need it to collect the tickets.

segments.title: Check in to the hotel

commute.summary: An 8 minute walk from Gare du Nord

segments.detail: Hotel d'Amiens on Rue des Deux Gares, an eight minute walk from Gare du Nord. It is a quiet twin room on the ground floor with air conditioning and good soundproofing. No breakfast, around 423 dollars including city tax, paid at the property. Check out is Friday by noon.

pin.name: Hotel d'Amiens
pin.address: 11 Rue des Deux Gares, 75010 Paris, France

segments.title: First evening in Paris
segments.detail: Drop your bags and explore. If you still have energy, the Louvre stays open late on Wednesdays until 9:45pm. Otherwise head to Canal Saint Martin, about 15 minutes on foot, for natural wine and small plates.

segments.title: Breakfast at the bakery
segments.info: Order at the counter like a local
segments.detail: Find a neighbourhood boulangerie near the hotel. A cafe au lait and a pain au chocolat, taken standing at the bar like a local.

segments.title: The Louvre
segments.info: Book a 9 to 10am slot, about 22 euros
segments.detail: It is closed on Tuesdays, so Thursday works well. Book a morning slot and head straight to the Mona Lisa before the groups arrive. The Venus de Milo and the Winged Victory are nearby. Allow two and a half to three hours.

segments.title: Picnic in the Tuileries
segments.info: Grab bread and cheese on the way

commute.summary: A short walk from the Louvre

segments.detail: Pick up supplies from a boulangerie and picnic in the gardens between the Louvre and Place de la Concorde. Around 15 to 20 euros.

segments.title: Le Marais and Notre Dame
segments.info: Reserve a free Notre Dame slot
segments.detail: Walk through the Marais, with its galleries and the falafel spots on Rue des Rosiers, over to the Ile de la Cite. Notre Dame reopened in December 2024. Entry is free but reserve a timed slot to skip the queue.

segments.title: Sunset in Montmartre
segments.info: Have your last Paris dinner up here

commute.summary: Take the metro up the hill

segments.detail: Take the metro up to Montmartre for Sacre Coeur, which is free, and the street artists on Place du Tertre. Have a terrace dinner with city views at dusk, around 45 to 65 euros.

pin.name: Basilique du Sacre Coeur
pin.address: 35 Rue du Chevalier de la Barre, 75018 Paris, France

days.label: The long travel day to Buxton

segments.title: Eurostar back to London
segments.detail: About two and a half hours direct to St Pancras. Get to Gare du Nord by 5:30am for check in, French passport control and security. This is the most time critical moment of the trip. The hotel is an eight minute walk from the station.

segments.title: Walk to Euston
segments.detail: You arrive into St Pancras at 8:30am. Euston is a 12 to 15 minute walk away. You have a big buffer before the 1:13pm train, so have a proper sit down breakfast. No need to rush.

segments.title: Train to Manchester
segments.info: Coach E, seat 33, catch the 1:13pm exactly
segments.detail: Just over two hours direct to Manchester Piccadilly. This is an advance single, so you have to board this exact 1:13pm train. Miss it and you have to buy a new full price ticket. It cost 43 pounds 50.

segments.title: Train to Buxton
segments.info: Buy on the day, about 5 to 8 pounds
segments.detail: Trains run hourly and take about an hour. Aim for something between 3:15 and 4:15pm. Buy at the station machine or in the Northern app, since there is no advance discount. Tap contactless.

segments.title: Arrive in Buxton
segments.info: You still need to book a hotel

commute.summary: A short walk from the station

segments.detail: Settle in, wander the Pavilion Gardens, have a low key dinner and an early night before the wedding. You still need to book a place to stay, so look at the Old Hall Hotel or the Palace Hotel and Spa.

segments.title: Morning in Buxton
segments.detail: Explore the spa town. The Pavilion Gardens and the restored Crescent are both worth a stroll.

pin.name: Buxton Pavilion Gardens
pin.address: St John's Rd, Buxton SK17 6BE, UK

segments.title: The wedding
segments.info: Smart formal, bring a light jacket
segments.detail: Confirm the exact time and venue with the couple. The dress code is smart formal, and a UK July can turn, so pack a light jacket and maybe waterproof shoes.

segments.title: Train to Manchester
segments.info: Buy on the day, check the Sunday times
segments.detail: Leave Buxton around 8:20am to reach Piccadilly by about 9:20am for the onward train. Northern can have Sunday disruptions, so check National Rail a few days before. Buy at the machine.

segments.title: Train to London
segments.detail: A flexible off peak single, valid only on London Northwestern and connecting services, not Avanti. About two and a quarter hours via Milton Keynes. Aim to be at Euston by around 12:30pm. It cost 42 pounds 90.

segments.title: Head to Heathrow
segments.detail: Walk to Paddington, about 10 minutes, then take the Elizabeth line straight to Heathrow Terminal 3, roughly 45 minutes and about 13 pounds. Aim to arrive by 2 to 2:30pm, a comfortable buffer before the flight.

segments.title: Fly home
segments.detail: Virgin Atlantic VS41, just under 11 hours direct back to San Francisco in economy, arriving the same day at 9:25pm local time. Be at Terminal 3 about three hours before, so by 3:30pm.
